links.outcome: Inclusion of poor or contraindicated antidepressants among choices GPT-4 considered optimal or good
links.effect: Poor or contraindicated medications were included among optimal/good choices in 24/50 (48%) of vignettes; at least one optimal choice was included in 38/50 (76%), with 0/5 for 2 vignettes.
links.quote: At least one of the poor choice or contraindicated medications was included among the choices considered optimal or good in 24/50 (48%) of vignettes.

links.outcome: Stability of GPT-4 antidepressant recommendations across 5 regenerations of each vignette
links.effect: Optimal choice included 5/5 times for 7 vignettes, 3/5 for 1, and 0/5 for 2, indicating mostly stable but inconsistent responses for some vignettes.
links.quote: At least one of the optimal medication choices was included among the best choices in 38/50 (76%) vignettes: 5/5 for 7 vignettes, 3/5 for 1, and 0/5 for 2.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4's antidepressant recommendations using clinical vignettes compared to expert consensus, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
